name: PodOS
author: Charles R. Bowen
description: PodOS notifications and tasks in the Omarchy bar, with desktop pop-ups for new notifications.

barWidget.description: Your PodOS user notifications grouped by day, with desktop pop-ups, and optionally your Doing and Need tasks.

schema.label: Desktop pop-ups for new notifications
schema.description: Polls PodOS in the background and shows a desktop notification for each new user notification, with Open and Mark read buttons.

schema.label: Tasks project
schema.description: PodOS project code (as in ?project=… on the dashboard) whose Doing and Need tasks owned by you appear in the Tasks tab. Leave empty to hide the tab.

schema.label: PodOS API URL
schema.description: Base URL of the PodOS API. Only change this for a non-production PodOS.

schema.label: PodOS dashboard URL
schema.description: Base URL of the PodOS dashboard. Links open, and avatars are fetched, only on this host and its subdomains.
